$comment: Dependency-audit policy for scripts/audit_npm.py. Any advisory at or above
failOnSeverity blocks CI unless an entry here matches the OBSERVED advisory
exactly: id, package, severity, scope, installedVersion and affectedRange.
A severity escalation or any metadata drift blocks and forces re-review, so
an entry cannot approve something other than what was assessed. Entries
expire; an expired or stale entry is itself a CI failure.

exceptions.title: React Router: Open redirect leading to XSS
exceptions.reason: No fix exists on the 6.x line. The GitHub advisory records first_patched_version=none for react-router-dom 6.x; the only upstream remedy is the react-router 7.18.x major line, which is a framework major migration and out of scope for a dependency-security change.
exceptions.exploitability: Requires an attacker-influenced navigation target. The single such sink is navigate(returnTo) in interlock-web/src/pages/OIDCCallback.tsx. Every producer of returnTo passes it through sanitizeReturnTo on both write and read, which requires the literal '/dashboard' prefix, so an authority-position payload ('//host', '/\host') can never reach the router.

exceptions.title: React Router: Open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate (CVE-2025-68470 bypass)
exceptions.reason: Patched only in react-router 7.18.0; no 6.x backport. Same major-migration constraint as GHSA-jjmj-jmhj-qwj2.
exceptions.exploitability: Same single sink and same guard as GHSA-jjmj-jmhj-qwj2. The backslash bypass needs the escape at the authority position (second character); sanitizeReturnTo forces characters 1-10 to be '/dashboard'.

exceptions.title: React Router: Arbitrary Constructor Injection via deserializeErrors() in React Router SSR Hydration
exceptions.reason: Patched only in react-router 7.18.0; no 6.x backport.
exceptions.exploitability: Unreachable. deserializeErrors() runs only on SSR hydration. interlock-web is a client-only Vite SPA: it contains no hydrateRoot, StaticRouter, renderToString, or createStaticHandler, and ships no server renderer.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Client-only build; absence of SSR entry points is asserted by interlock-web/tests/noSsrHydration.test.ts
